company.name: Oaises
company.shortDescription: Oaises creates laser-based energy efficient lighting systems.
company.description: Oæsis is the world’s first company that provides laser-based energy efficient grow lights for vertical farming. They offer a flexible design of their systems and the key benefits of laser technologies. This technology is capable of growing any kind of plants for indoor farming (such as micro greens, lettuces, herbs and berries) at commercial scale and maximizing yields effortless. It enables a yearly produce of fresh plants, with no need of pesticides as it is a controlled environment.
